summary: Evaluates the predictive performance of latent dynamical models against trial-averaged PSTH baselines by computing marginal log-likelihood improvements across neural populations.
use_when: does the latent dynamical model outperform PSTH baselines?
how much better is the latent model at fitting spike data than trial averages?
calculate the improvement distribution of neural latent models
compare LDM and PSTH model fitting accuracy for neurons
assess the predictive gains of latent variable models over static trial-averaged spike rates
avoid_when: Neural and behavioral measurements cannot be aligned on a common time base
